headline: A Life Saved, Then Returned: The Circle Closes
meta_description: In 1999, an off-duty nurse saved a boy's life with CPR after a baseball bat struck his chest. Seven years later, that same boy returned the favor.
summary_short: An off-duty nurse gave CPR to a Little League player after a baseball bat stopped his heart. Years later, he saved her life in return.
body:
A boy's life hung in the balance during a Little League game in 1999 when a baseball bat struck him in the chest and stopped his heart. An off-duty nurse was there—and her quick action performing CPR saved him.

Seven years later, in 2006, that same boy grew up and found himself in a position to give back. He saved the nurse's life, closing a circle of gratitude that spanned from childhood to young adulthood.

Their story shows how acts of kindness and skill ripple forward through time, touching lives in ways neither person could have predicted in that urgent moment on the baseball field.
